LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 5.3.1 ORDER OF ADJECTIVES

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.3: Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Order of Adjectives

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Order of Adjectives. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How can we use words to create vivid pictures of a person or place?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify various types of adjectives in texts
2. use the correct order of adjectives in oral and written texts

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

• Today’s maths focus is Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Order of Adjectives.

• Start with objects you can touch or draw — stones, sticks, bottle tops, or drawings in your book.

• Say the steps aloud as you work so you do not skip a stage.

• Check your answer with a second method or by estimating.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At the market, count 10 mangoes and put them in 2 groups of 5.

Example 2: In class, count the desks in your row and write the number in figures and in words.

Example 3: If you have 7 shillings and receive 5 more, you have 12 shillings.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Solve three short problems about Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Order of Adjectives using drawings.
2. Explain one solution to a partner in your own words.
3. Make up one new word problem set in your county or school.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five practice questions and solve them in your book.
2. Show your working clearly — not only the final answer.
3. Teach a younger learner one idea from this lesson with bottle tops or drawings.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Form sentences using adjectives of opinion, size, shape, age, colour, origin, material and purpose,
2. Listen to an audio text or watch a video and pick out different adjectives,
3. Learning to learn: It is promoted as the learner interracts with the order of different types of adjectives in various texts.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can we use words to create vivid pictures of a person or place?
2. Why is it important to order adjectives correctly?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Use objects or drawings when a sum feels hard.
2. Check every answer.
3. Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Order of Adjectives is used in real Kenyan life — market, school, and home.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
